transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I’m convinced certain people in my professional and art circles are secretly working together to damage my reputation and my practice, even though everyone keeps telling me it’s not really happening. It has just gotten to the point where I can't shake this feeling, and I don't know what to do anymore.
Besides these concerns about people working against you, have you experienced hearing voices or seeing things that other people cannot see?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear any strange voices or see things that other people can't see. It's really just about the concrete ways these specific people are coordinating against me.
Have you generally felt this kind of mistrust toward others throughout your entire life, or is this specific concern about your colleagues something that started more recently?

No, this isn't a lifelong thing at all. It really started about two years ago after a difficult breakup and has gradually gotten worse since then. Over the last couple of months, it has become a constant, intense feeling that these specific people are coordinating against me.
Since these worries became more intense over the last couple of months, have you also been feeling consistently down, hopeless, or lost interest in things you normally enjoy?

Yes, I've really lost interest in the things I used to love, and now I mostly just sit in my apartment with the TV on mute, ignoring texts and calls. I can't bring myself to care about going to gallery openings, seeing friends, or even cooking a real meal anymore. When I do go out, I feel completely flat and disconnected, like I'm just going through the motions.
Did these feelings of depression and losing interest in your hobbies start around the same time as your worries about your colleagues two years ago, or did they only develop recently?

Both the loss of interest and my general worries started around the same time, about two years ago after that difficult breakup. They have both slowly gotten worse since then, but the intense, nonstop feeling that people are actively coordinating against me has really escalated over the last couple of months.
During the past two years, has there ever been a period of at least two weeks where you did not feel depressed or down, but you still believed people were coordinating against you?

I'm not quite sure how to answer that, to be honest. I haven't really thought about my mood in that specific way or tried to separate it from the worries. It has all just felt like one big blur since everything started.
Have there been times over the last two years when your mood improved and you felt more like your usual self, but you still believed these people were actively working against you?

I'm not really sure, as I haven't noticed any distinct times where my mood significantly improved or felt normal while those worries remained. Ever since everything started, I've just felt consistently flat, stressed, and disconnected from everything.
Alongside feeling flat and disconnected, have you been experiencing strong feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or thoughts of wanting to end your life?

I definitely feel very flat and completely disconnected from my life right now. However, I don't experience feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt, and I've never had any thoughts of wanting to end my life.
How has your sleep been over these past two years, and have you noticed any major changes in your daily energy levels?

I haven't really noticed any major changes or problems with my sleep specifically. As for my energy, I'm not quite sure how to describe it other than just feeling generally flat, disconnected, and lacking motivation lately.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight, or have you been having trouble concentrating and making decisions lately?

I haven't really noticed any major changes in my appetite or weight, although I haven't had the motivation to cook real meals lately. I also haven't had specific trouble concentrating or making decisions, other than generally feeling flat and disconnected from everything.
You've described feeling flat and disconnected, but have you also experienced a persistent feeling of deep sadness, emptiness, or hopelessness over these past two years?

No, I wouldn't describe it as deep sadness or hopelessness. It's more of a persistent feeling of being completely flat, disconnected, and just unable to care about anything anymore. I feel more numb than sad, like I'm just going through the motions.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are not your own, such as being put into your head by someone else, or that others can somehow hear your thoughts?

No, I've never experienced anything like that. While I'm certain these people are coordinating against me, I've never felt like my thoughts were being put into my head or that anyone else could hear them.
Have you ever felt as though your body, movements, or actions are being controlled, influenced, or forced by an outside power or person, rather than being under your own control?
No, I've never felt like my body or actions are being controlled by an outside power. That doesn't align with my experiences at all. I still feel completely in control of my own movements.
Have you noticed your thoughts suddenly going blank or stopping, or has anyone mentioned that your speech is disorganized or difficult to follow?
No, I haven't really noticed my thoughts going blank like that at all. No one has ever told me that my speech is disorganized or hard to follow, either.

Do you avoid going out and feel disconnected mainly because you are afraid of what these people might do to you, or does this lack of motivation and flat feeling exist on its own, separate from your worries?

It's actually a combination of both. While I definitely avoid social events out of fear of running into the people working against me, the flat feeling and lack of motivation also exist on their own. Sitting at home with the TV on mute, ignoring texts, and not being able to care about basic things like cooking feels like a separate, heavy emptiness rather than just being afraid.
Have you been using any recreational drugs, alcohol, or prescription medications regularly over the past two years?
No, I don't really use recreational drugs or drink alcohol regularly. I also don't take any prescription medications.
Have you ever noticed normal, everyday events or objects around you suddenly having a special, highly personal meaning, as if they were signs or messages meant specifically for you?
No, I haven't really experienced anything like that. Everyday objects or random events don't seem to have any special, hidden messages or signs meant specifically for me.

How exactly do you believe these people are coordinating against you? Are they using everyday means like gossip and professional sabotage, or do you suspect they are using advanced technology, surveillance, or other unusual methods?

I believe they are using everyday digital communication rather than any advanced technology or surveillance. I have a strong suspicion that they have a quiet group chat or email chain where they coordinate to ignore my emails, reschedule meetings, and freeze me out to ruin my reputation.
Have family members or friends commented that you seem much less emotionally expressive, or that your face and voice don't show your feelings like they used to?

I'm not sure if anyone has used those exact words to describe me, but I definitely feel completely flat and empty inside when I am around other people. It really just feels like I'm disconnected and going through the motions for their sake.

Have you ever experienced periods lasting several days where you felt the exact opposite of flat—such as having unusually high energy, needing very little sleep, or feeling extremely happy and active?
No, I've never experienced periods like that at all. I have never had times where I felt unusually high energy, needed very little sleep, or felt extremely happy and active.

It sounds incredibly exhausting to carry this heavy, flat feeling of being so disconnected. Have you been able to share how much you're struggling with a trusted friend, family member, or a healthcare professional who can support you right now?

I actually confided in my sister, and she was the one who pushed me to see a psychiatrist, which is why I'm here today. I've tried talking to a few other people, but they usually just tell me I'm overthinking it or that it's not really happening. That response only makes me feel even more isolated and disconnected from everyone.
Have you been able to continue working and managing your daily responsibilities, or has this flat feeling made it difficult to handle even basic tasks like cleaning or keeping up with your bills?

My work and daily life have been severely affected; I've lost several long-term clients and had to cut my hours way back at my financial practice. I also struggle to care about basic daily tasks, often just sitting in my apartment with the TV on mute, ignoring texts, and failing to cook real meals.
Is there any history of mental health conditions in your family, such as schizophrenia, depression, or bipolar disorder?

As far as I know, there isn't any history of mental health conditions like schizophrenia, depression, or bipolar disorder in my family. My relatives have never really struggled with anything like that, at least to my knowledge.
Have you recently had a physical exam or blood tests to rule out any medical conditions that might be contributing to this persistent flat feeling and lack of motivation?

No, I haven't had any recent physical exams or blood tests done for these symptoms. I'm not really sure if anyone has suggested doing that yet, as I've mostly just been focused on trying to deal with how I've been feeling.
Have you ever experienced any head injuries, seizures, or other neurological conditions in your life?
No, I have never experienced any head injuries, seizures, or other neurological conditions in my life. As far as I know, my health has been completely normal in those areas.
Before these struggles began two years ago, had you ever experienced any mental health concerns or seen a therapist or psychiatrist?
No, I had never experienced any mental health struggles before this all started two years ago. I had also never seen a therapist or a psychiatrist before now.
Do you ever feel like strangers on the street, people on TV, or internet posts are talking about you or making subtle references to your situation?

No, I haven't really experienced that. My concerns are specifically focused on the people in my professional and art networks, rather than strangers, the TV, or the internet. It's just those specific groups that I feel are working against me.
When you talk about feeling flat and disconnected, do you find it difficult to experience any positive emotions at all, even when something good happens or when you are with your sister?

Yes, it is incredibly difficult to feel any genuine positive emotions, even when something objectively good happens. When I spend time with my sister, whom I really appreciate for helping me, I still feel completely flat and disconnected. I just end up going through the motions for her sake rather than actually feeling any warmth or joy.
